protocol_note: This protocol defines the measurements to collect during the F6 spike performance run on reference hardware RHW-001. No data has been collected yet. All thresholds are preregistered from design.md §4.7.8 and §4.8.9. Execute CMD-MG-PROFILE-SPIKE to collect data and populate evidence/F6/run-001/performance/results/.

idle.description: No competing local model inference. System at desktop idle. Only KRIA process running. No browser, no LLM backend process active.
warm_up_steps: Launch KRIA and navigate to Knowledge destination.
Execute one path query (discard data — warm-up only).
Wait 5 seconds for JIT/GC to settle.

local_model_contention.description: Local model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via ONNX Runtime) actively performing embedding inference on a background corpus of 500 records simultaneously with 3D rendering. This simulates the worst-case ambient cognition scenario from design.md §4.8.
local_model_contention.contention_process: CMD-MG-CONTENTION-LOAD — background embedding loop on mg-medium-v2 entity records, one batch per 200ms, serialized through the same ort runtime instance used by the retrieval pipeline.
warm_up_steps: Launch KRIA and navigate to Knowledge destination.
Wait 10 seconds for thermal and JIT equilibrium.
Execute one path query (discard data — warm-up only).

fps.description: Rendered frames per second during active path-scene interaction.
fps.tool_api: requestAnimationFrame timestamp delta, computed over a 1-second sliding window by ProfilingSession.addFrameSample()
fps.collection_note: Record timestamps via performance.now() at each rAF callback. Derive FPS from inverse of mean frame time over the trailing 60 frames.
fps.pass_threshold: p95 frame time ≤ 33.3ms (≥30 FPS at p95)

frame_time.description: Per-frame render duration from rAF callback start to draw-call completion.
frame_time.tool_api: performance.now() delta bracketing the Three.js renderer.render() call in graphCanvas3DSpike.ts
frame_time.collection_note: Record durationMs = end - start around each renderer.render() invocation. Feed into ProfilingSession.addFrameSample().

cpu_pct.description: CPU utilization percentage of the KRIA process during active rendering.
cpu_pct.tool_api: Linux: /proc/[pid]/stat sampled at 500ms intervals via CMD-MG-PROFILE-CPU sidecar; macOS: top -pid [pid] -l 0 -s 0.5
cpu_pct.collection_note: Average over the 60-second measurement window under each load condition.

gpu_pct.description: GPU utilization percentage during active 3D path-scene rendering.
gpu_pct.tool_api: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits -l 1 (NVIDIA); intel_gpu_top (Intel); radeontop (AMD). Fallback: unavailable — record as null.
gpu_pct.sample_unit: percent (0–100) or null if GPU monitoring unavailable
gpu_pct.collection_note: Sample at 1-second intervals for 60 seconds during peak rendering.

ram_bytes.description: RSS (resident set size) of the KRIA process during active rendering.
ram_bytes.tool_api: Linux: /proc/[pid]/status VmRSS sampled at 500ms intervals; macOS: ps -o rss= -p [pid]
ram_bytes.collection_note: Record peak and mean RSS over the 60-second window. Peak is the binding threshold value.
ram_bytes.pass_threshold: peak RSS ≤ 512 MiB during rendering under local-model contention

vram_bytes.description: GPU VRAM consumed by the WebGL context for the 3D path scene.
vram_bytes.tool_api: WEBGL_debug_renderer_info + EXT_disjoint_timer_query for size estimation; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits (NVIDIA); null if unavailable.
vram_bytes.sample_unit: bytes or null if VRAM monitoring unavailable
vram_bytes.collection_note: Sample at scene load, after 30s of interaction, and at peak. Record minimum, mean, peak.
vram_bytes.pass_threshold: peak VRAM ≤ 256 MiB for the WebGL context

heap_bytes.description: JavaScript heap used and total bytes during rendering.
heap_bytes.tool_api: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize and totalJSHeapSize (Chrome/Chromium WebView only). Fallback: HeapSample via ProfilingSession.addHeapSample() with estimated values.
heap_bytes.collection_note: Sample at 500ms intervals. Record peak heapUsedBytes over the window. Feed into ProfilingSession.addHeapSample().

gc_pause_ms.description: GC pause durations observed during rendering.
gc_pause_ms.tool_api: PerformanceObserver({ entryTypes: ['measure'] }) wrapping GC events in Chromium DevTools; or Node.js --expose-gc with gc() timing. Production: indirect detection via frame-time spike correlation.
gc_pause_ms.sample_count_required: all GC pauses during the 60-second window (may be 0 if no GC occurs)
gc_pause_ms.collection_note: Record every detected GC pause as a GcPauseSample. Feed into ProfilingSession.addGcPauseSample(). Record gcType as 'minor', 'major', or 'unknown'.

idle_cpu_delta.description: CPU utilization delta between idle baseline and active-rendering state. Measures the incremental CPU cost of the 3D renderer.
idle_cpu_delta.tool_api: Computed from cpu_pct measurements: idle_cpu_delta = mean_rendering_cpu_pct - mean_idle_cpu_pct. Both measurements use the same sampling tool.
idle_cpu_delta.sample_count_required: derived from cpu_pct samples (no additional samples required)
idle_cpu_delta.collection_note: Measure CPU under pure idle (no rendering), then under rendering. Subtract. This isolates the renderer's CPU contribution.
idle_cpu_delta.pass_threshold: idle_cpu_delta ≤ 40 percentage points under local-model contention
idle_cpu_delta.fail_threshold: idle_cpu_delta > 40 percentage points under local-model contention

fps_p95_frame_time_ms.description: p95 frame time must be ≤ 33.3ms (≥30 FPS) — from design.md §4.7.8 quality ladder

fps_p99_frame_time_ms.description: p99 frame time must be ≤ 50ms — prevents visible jank at the 99th percentile

gc_pause_max_ms.description: No GC pause may be ≥ 50ms — GC pauses above this threshold cause a visible dropped frame

idle_cpu_delta_pct.description: Renderer incremental CPU ≤ 40 percentage points above idle baseline

minimum_frame_samples.description: At least 30 FrameTimingSamples required for p95/p99 computation — matches ProfilingSession.computeP95FrameTime() null guard

interaction_phases.description: Load the maximum-path-scene for mg-medium-v2/0.1.0 (longest available path in the fixture). Measure time from query dispatch to first rendered frame.
Orbit/pan/zoom the 3D scene through 10 distinct camera positions (preregistered in CMD-MG-PROFILE-SPIKE). Each camera transition is triggered by a simulated pointer event.
Select 5 distinct nodes in sequence via simulated click events. For each selection, allow the Inspector to load (up to 2s). Measure rendering during Inspector load contention.
Allow scene to go idle (no input, no scene change) for 3 seconds. Verify shouldStopRendering fires at >2000ms per design §4.8.9. Measure CPU during idle render-stop.
Trigger a simulated WebGL context loss event (WEBGL_lose_context.loseContext()). Measure time to fallback activation and any associated GC pauses.

integration_points: Call ProfilingSession.addFrameSample() at each rAF callback in graphCanvas3DSpike.ts.
Call ProfilingSession.addHeapSample() every 500ms via a setInterval during the profiling window.
Call ProfilingSession.addGcPauseSample() from the PerformanceObserver GC handler.
Call ProfilingSession.toReport() at the end of each interaction phase to snapshot metrics.
Check ProfilingSession.checkFpsThreshold() and ProfilingSession.checkGcThreshold() after each phase; log PASS/FAIL/insufficient-data.

files.description: ProfilingReport for all phases under idle load condition
ProfilingReport for all phases under local-model contention
All FrameTimingSamples collected under idle condition
All FrameTimingSamples collected under contention condition
CPU/GPU/RAM/VRAM time-series sampled by CMD-MG-PROFILE-CPU sidecar

go_no_go_criteria.go: All eight thresholds pass under BOTH idle and local-model contention conditions.
go_no_go_criteria.no_go: Any single threshold fails under local-model contention. A fail under idle only (with pass under contention) is treated as a protocol error — re-run idle.
go_no_go_criteria.insufficient_data: Any ProfilingSession reports insufficient-data for fps or gc thresholds after a full run. Re-run the affected phase with increased sample count.
